raw_response:
I will keep cotton as my main crop this year because my land is only 8 mu, I know cotton best, and with some family labor going off-farm I need a plan I can manage from experience. I have 30 years of farming, so I will not spread myself too thin. I will put most of the land into cotton for cash income, and I will keep some maize for steady grain output and some mungbean because it needs less fertilizer and helps spread risk. Since I have well irrigation, I will use it at the key times instead of depending only on rain. I will use better seed where it matters, but I will keep inputs moderate because I do not want to spend too much on a small farm. For cotton I will fertilize and spray more carefully because it is my main crop and needs closer management. For maize I will use hybrid seed and keep management simple for stable yield. For mungbean I will keep costs lower, use lighter fertilizer, and manage it more extensively.
